skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and integrate knowledge of information systems and human resource management to build an information system for an organization.
Evaluate and determine the needs for human resource information systems, analyze and select human resource information systems, and build simple human resource information systems for organizations.
Effectively communicate in writing and verbally, write reports and presentations, and work independently and in teams.
Demonstrate independent learning, research, and teamwork skills.
Develop an awareness of social context, professional ethics, and social responsibility.
Understand the concept, significance, and role of human resource information systems, and their contribution to organizational success.
Analyze and evaluate human resource metrics and their applications.
Understand the architecture of human resource information systems and plan their deployment.

minimum_entry_skills.skill_name: Basic Understanding of Human Resource Management
